title: Baby Scorpio hides in the nursery.
old_caption: Baby Scorpio hid in a dust cloud with one pink sock sticking out. Taurus brought peas every day for a hundred days. Day 100: boo. Who waited for you to come out of your shell?

title: Baby Taurus has one food.
old_caption: Baby Taurus had one food: peas, forever. Banana, broccoli and a tiny cake all got slowly pushed away. Then a stargazing night, one cookie from Cancer, and a snack basket for everyone. What's your one food?

title: Baby Virgo lined up the crayons.
old_caption: Baby Virgo lined up the crayons by colour at age one. At six, Pisces spilled blue paint over Virgo's perfectly ruled night sky. Then it started to look like space. Who's your messy best friend?

title: Aquarius visited the planet that rolls.
old_caption: Aquarius launched sideways, found a planet that also rolls on its side, and briefly turned comms off. Leo kept calling anyway. Tag the friend who always brings you home.

title: Aries is racing to the equinox.
old_caption: Aries launched on two, flew to the equinox, and found out the start line moved to Pisces. Pisces was holding the flag the whole time. Which sign is always racing?

title: Cancer is lost in the Beehive.
old_caption: Cancer flew to the Beehive, found hundreds of glowing stars, and asked every single one 'home?' Nope. Capricorn left the porch light on. Who leaves the light on for you?

title: Capricorn is visiting its boss.
old_caption: Capricorn flew to Saturn with a five-year plan and a tie. Saturn was out of office, lying on its rings in sunglasses. Turns out the boss floats in a bathtub. Tag your workaholic.

title: Gemini found out Castor is six stars.
old_caption: Gemini flew all the way to Castor to say hi, and found six stars all talking at once. For once, Gemini couldn't get a word in. Saturn's advice from Houston: try listening. Ever met someone who out-talked you?

title: Mission 05: Regulus, the lion's heart star.
old_caption: Leo flew to Regulus, the lion's heart star, for a dance-off and got dizzy trying to match its spin. Aquarius on the radio: try half time. Who in your life spins too fast?

title: Libra is shopping for a planet.
old_caption: Libra and Aries went house hunting in space. Aries said 'sold' to every spot. One was boiling, one was frozen, and the scale would not stop swinging. Who decides in your house?
